findings: COA found the district compliant with its Water Safety Plan in 2024, and in the same observation reported 1,490 complaints, up 20.75% from 2023.
The operator served 22 barangays each year from 2022 to 2024, short of its target of 23 (2022) and 24 (2023, 2024). COA does not name the barangays left out.
The rewards and penalties framework the joint venture calls for (Sec. 8.5.4) was still not finalized in 2024, five years in.
The 6% performance bond was not forfeited in any year, though 1 to 2 of 6 targets were missed each year from 2022 to 2024.
In 2024, 135 of 170 operator capital projects (₱125.0M) had no supporting documents.
10 of 15 prior-year COA recommendations had not been implemented as of 2024.
findingsCite: Author's extract of COA Annual Audit Reports on MCWD, CY 2019-2024 (MCWD_COA_Record_2014-2024)
